subject: Amelio Health: SCIM delta manifest + RBAC mapping consolidation
messages:
From: Alex Brooks <abrooks@ameliohealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@ameliohealth.com>, Taylor Nguyen <t.nguyen@ameliohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: SCIM delta + RBAC mapping for SOC2/SIG intake

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Amelio is moving toward a procurement review and our security team asked for a couple of items to close the identity/access section of the SIG and CAIQ: 

1) A representative SCIM delta export (CSV) showing create/update/delete events for the last 90 days, with timestamp, source, and the attributes you sync (email, externalId, groups). We don't need actual PII beyond the email column — redacted sample is fine.

2) An RBAC mapping sheet that ties your console roles to effective privileges (what API actions or cluster-level access each role implies). If you have a template that shows service accounts and role ownership that would help.

3) Any short guidance on least-privilege recommendations you enforce (e.g., default deny, role scoping by org/project). We will attach these to our SOC2/CAIQ packet.

Can you confirm what format you prefer and a target by EOD Friday (6/11)? Procurement would like to start the legal review next week.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call if it's easier.

Best,
Alex
Alex Brooks
Director of IT Security
Amelio Health

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alex Brooks <abrooks@ameliohealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@ameliohealth.com>, Taylor Nguyen <t.nguyen@ameliohealth.com>, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + RBAC mapping for SOC2/SIG intake

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide those. Plan below: 

- SCIM delta: we'll produce a redacted CSV sample (scim-delta-sample.csv) showing create/update/delete events with a minimal set of attributes. No PII beyond email; we'll hash any externalId values.
- RBAC mapping: attach a canonical mapping template (rbac-mapping-template.xlsx) that includes role name, scope (org/project), allowed actions, and owner. We'll also add a separate sheet for service accounts.
- Least-privilege guidance: short one-page summary and callouts in the RBAC sheet for recommended pinning and role scoping.

I'll attach the stubs to this thread and aim to get the initial bundle to you by EOD Friday (6/11). If your security team prefers a signed assertion sample for SOC2 we can include a short PDF summary (soc2-assertion-summary.pdf) that lists our relevant control families.

Couple questions for your team to confirm before we generate the CSV:
- Do you want user identifiers redacted as hashes or replaced with placeholders (user-1@redacted)?
- For group membership, should we include full membership lists or just group membership change events?

If helpful I can loop in our provisioning lead (Sean Gallagher) to confirm format.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: rbac-mapping-template.xlsx (stub), soc2-assertion-summary.pdf (stub)

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Alex Brooks <abrooks@ameliohealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + RBAC mapping for SOC2/SIG intake

On Tue, Jun 9, 2026 at 11:02 AM marissa_cole@redwood.com wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide those. Plan below: 

Hi all — chipping in with a couple implementation notes from the infra side to ensure the delivered samples match what your security team expects: 

- SCIM deltas: we'll export a 90-day rolling delta in CSV with columns: event_id, timestamp (ISO8601), action (create/update/delete), externalId (hashed), email (redacted placeholder or hashed per your answer), source (SSO|API|Admin), groups (pipe-separated), changed_attributes (JSON-stringified). We'll include a short README in the Drive folder that explains column semantics.
- RBAC mapping: our console roles do not map 1:1 to cloud IAM — we will show effective privileges and include notes where a role grants access to runtime components (e.g., model-deploy, inference-admin). We'll flag any roles that are intended for service-to-service automation and list owner and last-used timestamp where available.
- Least privilege: by default we enforce deny-by-default on runtime APIs, require role scoping by team for production model deployments, and recommend timebound service account keys. We'll add a short checklist you can paste into CAIQ responses.

We will scrub any PII and provide the CSV with hashed IDs unless Amelio explicitly requests placeholders. Prefer to use hashes for audit reproducibility.

Deliverables will be dropped to the Drive folder (link below) and I will create a quick JIRA ticket (IAM-478) to track outstanding redaction/owner confirmations.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: scim-delta-sample.csv (will be generated), rbac-mapping-template.xlsx (already attached by Marissa)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alex Brooks <abrooks@ameliohealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@ameliohealth.com>, Taylor Nguyen <t.nguyen@ameliohealth.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + RBAC mapping for SOC2/SIG intake

Alex / Procurement team — quick status update: 

- I've uploaded the redacted SCIM delta sample (scim-delta-sample.csv), the RBAC mapping template (rbac-mapping-template.xlsx), and a short SOC2 assertion summary (soc2-assertion-summary.pdf) to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAMELIO-iam-collection
- We used hashed externalIds by default and replaced emails with placeholders (user-###@redacted) for the CSV. If you prefer hashed emails instead, we can regenerate quickly — confirm which you want.
- Sean created JIRA IAM-478 to capture the final owner confirmations and any last-minute redaction changes.

Next steps: please confirm whether the placeholder email approach is acceptable or if you need hashed values (I can have a hashed export by EOD Monday). If Procurement has everything they need for the legal packet, let us know and we'll mark this ticket ready.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the CSV columns.

Regards,
Marissa

Attachments: scim-delta-sample.csv (redacted stub), rbac-mapping-template.xlsx, soc2-assertion-summary.pdf
